step_by_step_process: Book an appointment at nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra or Post Office
Take demographic documents (Birth Certificate, Voter ID, or School Leaving Cert)
Give biometrics (fingerprints, iris, and photo)
Track enrolment using EID slip online on myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in

required_proofs: Ration Card or Salary Slip / Gram Pradhan verification
step_by_step_process: Register on state e-District portal (e.g. edistrict.up.gov.in) or visit Jan Seva Kendra (CSC)
Fill online application form and select Revenue Services > Income Certificate
Upload scanned copies of Aadhaar, self-declaration, and photo
Pay ₹15-₹30 application fee
Lekhpal/Patwari conducts local inquiry within 7 days
Download digitally signed certificate from portal or collect from CSC

required_proofs: Father/Relative's older caste certificate or 1950 family proof
step_by_step_process: Visit state e-District portal or local CSC center
Submit applicant details along with father's caste record
Patwari/Lekhpal verifies community lineage in village record
Tehsildar approves and signs digital certificate
Apply via e-District portal under 'Niwas Praman Patra'
Upload proof of residence showing stay in state for > 3-5 years
Patwari reports confirmation
Download digitally signed certificate

issuing_authority: Any Nationalized / Scheduled Commercial Bank / India Post Payments Bank
step_by_step_process: Visit nearest bank branch or IPPB postman with Aadhaar and photos
Open Zero-balance PM Jan Dhan Yojana account if low income
Request Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) / NPCI Aadhaar seeding form
Verify NPCI mapping via *99*99*1# or UIDAI portal

doc_name: Bonafide Certificate & Fee Receipt (प्रवेश व फीस रसीद)
issuing_authority: Principal / Registrar of Enrolled Educational Institution
step_by_step_process: Contact college administration / scholarship desk
Obtain Bonafide Certificate stating course, year, and non-refundable fee structure
Ensure College AISHE / Affiliation code is active on UP Scholarship portal
Fill online family unit form on FCS portal or submit at Supply Inspector office
Provide bank account details of female head of family
Field verification by Supply Inspector / Village Gram Panchayat
Ration card number generated and added to NFSA portal

doc_name: UP BOCW Shramik Card (भवन एवं सन्निर्माण कर्मकार कार्ड)
issuing_authority: UP Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
required_proofs: 90-day construction work certificate from contractor or Gram Pradhan
step_by_step_process: Apply online on upbocw.in or visit CSC / Labour Office
Upload 90 days work self-attestation
Pay nominal registration fee ₹20 and yearly contribution ₹20
Labour Enforcement Officer (LEO) verifies
Download Shramik Registration Certificate

doc_name: Land Revenue Record / Khatauni (भूलेख खतौनी / खसरा)
required_proofs: Gata / Khasra number or Land Owner Name
step_by_step_process: Go to upbhulekh.gov.in
Select District, Tehsil, and Village
Enter Gata number or account holder name
View or download authenticated RoR (Khatauni copy)

doc_name: Unique Disability ID / UDID Card (दिव्यांग प्रमाण पत्र)
issuing_authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
required_proofs: Medical Assessment by District Hospital Medical Board
step_by_step_process: Apply online on swavlambancard.gov.in
Book slot with CMO / District Medical Board for physical evaluation
Medical board certifies disability percentage (> 40% for welfare eligibility)
UDID card issued with national disability registry number
